slides.statSub: Four teams. Same record. Three weeks left.
slides.say:
Dylan, Hoa, Jason and Erick.
Only one other year since 2021 had four teams at 6‑5 after Week 11.

slides.title: The tiebreaker is points

cards.name: Dylan
cards.ln: 1,452.64 points, most in the league. Odds 82%.

cards.name: Jason
cards.ln: 1,371.30 points. Holding the last spot. Odds 59%.

cards.name: Erick
cards.ln: 1,325.46 points, ninth in the league. Odds 53%.

slides.kicker: Same record. Erick is out on points alone.

slides.title: Eleven teams were 6‑5 after Week 11
slides.kicker: Nobody went 3‑0. Nobody went 1‑2. The one 2‑1 team that missed, Tola in 2023, lost a five-way tie at 8‑6 on points.

slides.title: 2024 had four, too
slides.say:
Hoa, David and Matt each went 2‑1 and got in. Tola went 0‑3 and didn't.

After Week 11 that year, Tola and David were separated by 0.04 points. David won the title.

slides.title: It starts Sunday
slides.say:
Hoa vs. Dylan, 6‑5 against 6‑5. Jason gets Drew, who is 5‑6 with the second-most points in the league. Erick gets Tola. Hoa and Erick meet in Week 14.

History offers two options from here: 2‑1 or 0‑3. Nothing else has been attempted.
